data_tooling.name: build-your-own-x
data_tooling.summary: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
data_tooling.summary_en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.

ui_devex.name: node
ui_devex.summary: Node.js 是一个基于 Chrome V8 引擎的 JavaScript 运行时环境，让开发者能够使用 JavaScript 构建服务器端应用，解决了前后端语言不统一的问题。它采用事件驱动、非阻塞 I/O 模型，通过单线程处理高并发请求，避免了传统多线程的内存开销和上下文切换成本。开发者可以用它快速搭建实时聊天应用、RESTful API 和微服务架构，结合 npm 生态系统中丰富的模块库，轻松集成数据库、文件处理等核心功能，特别适合需要高并发的网络应用场景。
ui_devex.summary_en: Node.js is a JavaScript runtime that enables developers to build scalable server-side applications using JavaScript outside browsers, solving the challenge of using one language across full-stack development. Its event-driven, non-blocking I/O architecture efficiently handles concurrent requests without creating multiple threads, making it lightweight and fast. Developers can use Node.js to create real-time web apps, APIs, and microservices, extending functionality through npm's vast package ecosystem for everything from web servers to database connectors.

ui_devex.name: bitchat
ui_devex.summary: bitchat 是一款基于蓝牙 Mesh 网络的去中心化聊天应用，支持端到端加密，无需互联网即可在 iOS 和 macOS 设备间通信，风格类似 IRC。其技术核心是结合 Apple 的 Multipeer Connectivity 框架进行设备发现，并利用 Nostr 协议实现消息的去中心化中继，形成自组织的弹性网络。你可以将其用于户外活动、网络中断时的本地群聊，或作为构建安全、点对点应用的参考实现。项目采用 Unlicense 许可，鼓励自由使用和修改。
ui_devex.summary_en: bitchat is a Bluetooth mesh chat app providing decentralized, end-to-end encrypted messaging for iOS and macOS without internet, evoking IRC-style simplicity. Its core strength lies in combining Multipeer Connectivity's device pairing with Nostr's relay mechanism to create a robust mesh network that works offline. You can use it for local group chats at events, secure communication during outages, or as a template for building resilient peer-to-peer apps.

ui_devex.name: jenkins
ui_devex.summary: Jenkins 是一个开源的自动化服务器，专为持续集成与持续交付（CI/CD）而设计。它的核心能力是将构建、测试、部署等流程定义为代码（Pipeline as Code），通过 Groovy 脚本灵活编排。其最大优势在于拥有庞大的插件生态，几乎能与所有开发工具无缝集成。典型应用场景包括自动化测试、代码质量检查、多环境部署等。团队可通过声明式或脚本化流水线轻松定制工作流，实现从代码提交到上线的全自动化。
ui_devex.summary_en: Jenkins is an open-source automation server that streamlines continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD). It excels at building, testing, and deploying software pipelines as code, allowing teams to automate repetitive tasks. Its strength lies in a vast plugin ecosystem, enabling integration with virtually any tool. Typical use cases include automated testing, code quality checks, and deployment to production. Developers can define pipelines via Groovy DSL, making it highly customizable.

ui_devex.name: bitchat-android
ui_devex.summary: bitchat-android 是一款基于蓝牙 Mesh 网络的离线聊天应用，无需互联网或蜂窝网络，提供类似 IRC 的即时通讯体验。它利用蓝牙低功耗 Mesh 技术，让设备间通过中继转发消息，形成自组织的对等网络，覆盖范围随节点增多而扩展。适用于无网络环境下的通信，如户外探险、灾后救援或大型聚会。用户只需安装应用，即可与附近设备组成网络，实现文本消息的发送和接收，操作简单且无需额外设施。
ui_devex.summary_en: bitchat-android is a Bluetooth mesh chat app that enables offline, decentralized communication without internet or cellular networks, channeling the IRC experience. It uses Bluetooth Low Energy mesh networking to relay messages between devices, forming a self-organizing peer-to-peer network that scales with proximity. Ideal for remote areas, disaster scenarios, or events where infrastructure is limited, you can quickly set up instant messaging by installing the app and connecting with nearby devices.

deployment_serving.name: jenkins
deployment_serving.summary: Jenkins 是一个开源的自动化服务器，专为持续集成与持续交付（CI/CD）而设计。它的核心能力是将构建、测试、部署等流程定义为代码（Pipeline as Code），通过 Groovy 脚本灵活编排。其最大优势在于拥有庞大的插件生态，几乎能与所有开发工具无缝集成。典型应用场景包括自动化测试、代码质量检查、多环境部署等。团队可通过声明式或脚本化流水线轻松定制工作流，实现从代码提交到上线的全自动化。
deployment_serving.summary_en: Jenkins is an open-source automation server that streamlines continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD). It excels at building, testing, and deploying software pipelines as code, allowing teams to automate repetitive tasks. Its strength lies in a vast plugin ecosystem, enabling integration with virtually any tool. Typical use cases include automated testing, code quality checks, and deployment to production. Developers can define pipelines via Groovy DSL, making it highly customizable.

deployment_serving.name: open-code-review
deployment_serving.summary: Open-Code-Review是阿里巴巴开源的混合架构代码审查工具，结合确定性流水线与LLM代理。规则引擎精准检测空指针、SQL注入等低级问题，大语言模型负责理解上下文，发现逻辑缺陷与设计异味。两者互补，输出行级评论，可直接部署为GitHub/GitLab机器人或通过API集成CI/CD。该工具适合大规模项目，在保障基础合规的同时捕捉复杂语义问题，配置OpenAI/Anthropic兼容API即可体验。
deployment_serving.summary_en: Open-Code-Review is a hybrid code review tool that combines deterministic pipelines with LLM agents, battle-tested at Alibaba scale. Its key technical insight is the synergy: rule-based checks (NPE, XSS, SQL injection) catch low-level issues precisely, while the LLM understands context for higher-level concerns like logic errors or design smells. The tool outputs line-level comments, making reviews actionable. You can deploy it as a GitHub or GitLab bot, or integrate via API. Use it to automate thorough, context-aware code reviews in your CI/CD pipeline.

deployment_serving.name: amnezia-client
deployment_serving.summary: Amnezia VPN Client 是一款开源跨平台 VPN 客户端，旨在帮助用户突破网络封锁并保护在线隐私。它的独特之处在于支持 OpenVPN、WireGuard、Shadowsocks、IKEv2 以及 Cloak 混淆等多种协议，能灵活适应不同网络环境，尤其是严格的防火墙。技术亮点在于集成多种协议于一身，并提供一键式服务器安装脚本，降低自建 VPN 门槛。你可以在官网下载桌面或移动端应用，配合自有服务器或第三方配置直接使用，实现安全、自由的网络访问。
deployment_serving.summary_en: Amnezia VPN Client is an open-source, cross-platform VPN tool designed to bypass censorship and protect privacy. It uniquely supports multiple protocols including OpenVPN, WireGuard, Shadowsocks, IKEv2, and Cloak obfuscation, making it adaptable to restrictive networks. You can use it by downloading the client, setting up your own server via the included server installer, or importing custom configurations for instant secure browsing.

framework_core.name: bitchat
framework_core.summary: bitchat 是一款基于蓝牙 Mesh 网络的去中心化聊天应用，支持端到端加密，无需互联网即可在 iOS 和 macOS 设备间通信，风格类似 IRC。其技术核心是结合 Apple 的 Multipeer Connectivity 框架进行设备发现，并利用 Nostr 协议实现消息的去中心化中继，形成自组织的弹性网络。你可以将其用于户外活动、网络中断时的本地群聊，或作为构建安全、点对点应用的参考实现。项目采用 Unlicense 许可，鼓励自由使用和修改。
framework_core.summary_en: bitchat is a Bluetooth mesh chat app providing decentralized, end-to-end encrypted messaging for iOS and macOS without internet, evoking IRC-style simplicity. Its core strength lies in combining Multipeer Connectivity's device pairing with Nostr's relay mechanism to create a robust mesh network that works offline. You can use it for local group chats at events, secure communication during outages, or as a template for building resilient peer-to-peer apps.

agents_workflows.name: open-code-review
agents_workflows.summary: Open-Code-Review是阿里巴巴开源的混合架构代码审查工具，结合确定性流水线与LLM代理。规则引擎精准检测空指针、SQL注入等低级问题，大语言模型负责理解上下文，发现逻辑缺陷与设计异味。两者互补，输出行级评论，可直接部署为GitHub/GitLab机器人或通过API集成CI/CD。该工具适合大规模项目，在保障基础合规的同时捕捉复杂语义问题，配置OpenAI/Anthropic兼容API即可体验。
agents_workflows.summary_en: Open-Code-Review is a hybrid code review tool that combines deterministic pipelines with LLM agents, battle-tested at Alibaba scale. Its key technical insight is the synergy: rule-based checks (NPE, XSS, SQL injection) catch low-level issues precisely, while the LLM understands context for higher-level concerns like logic errors or design smells. The tool outputs line-level comments, making reviews actionable. You can deploy it as a GitHub or GitLab bot, or integrate via API. Use it to automate thorough, context-aware code reviews in your CI/CD pipeline.

security_safety.name: amnezia-client
security_safety.summary: Amnezia VPN Client 是一款开源跨平台 VPN 客户端，旨在帮助用户突破网络封锁并保护在线隐私。它的独特之处在于支持 OpenVPN、WireGuard、Shadowsocks、IKEv2 以及 Cloak 混淆等多种协议，能灵活适应不同网络环境，尤其是严格的防火墙。技术亮点在于集成多种协议于一身，并提供一键式服务器安装脚本，降低自建 VPN 门槛。你可以在官网下载桌面或移动端应用，配合自有服务器或第三方配置直接使用，实现安全、自由的网络访问。
security_safety.summary_en: Amnezia VPN Client is an open-source, cross-platform VPN tool designed to bypass censorship and protect privacy. It uniquely supports multiple protocols including OpenVPN, WireGuard, Shadowsocks, IKEv2, and Cloak obfuscation, making it adaptable to restrictive networks. You can use it by downloading the client, setting up your own server via the included server installer, or importing custom configurations for instant secure browsing.
